chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Abi Hamza, who said:
Abu Ja'far (عليه السلام) said: 'Do not bring fire near your dead' — meaning the incense fumigation (al-dukhna).

key_terms.الدُّخْنَةَ: incense fumigation — burning aromatic substances to perfume with smoke; the specific practice being prohibited here
key_terms.النَّارَ: fire — here specified by the narrator to mean fumigation fire, not fire in the general sense
key_terms.مَوْتَاكُمُ: your dead — the deceased placed in your care and responsibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permitted in Shia fiqh to fumigate the funeral shroud (kafan) with incense smoke (dukhna)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (عليه السلام) prohibits bringing fire near the deceased, with the narrator clarifying that 'fire' here refers specifically to al-dukhna — the practice of perfuming the body or shroud with incense smoke. Cited within the chapter on fumigating the funeral shroud (tajmir al-kafan) in al-Istibsar, this narration establishes a legal prohibition against using such fumigation during funeral preparation.
